# gh-1538: [GOAL] Slim nightly to builds + integration-only: drop test legs duplicated by the pre-merge gate

## Description

## Owner directive

Separate card from #1537. Once #1537 makes the SM pre-merge validation the single test gate, the nightly workflow must stop re-running anything that gate already covers. Nightly keeps only what belongs there by nature:

- **Builds** (all store/desktop targets, as today).
- **Integration-tagged tests** (PTY/CLI integration, LLM-calling `integration` tag) — they are deliberately excluded from pre-commit and PR gates (slow, networked, flakier), and nightly is their only home. This leg pays for itself: it caught the #1510 TUI wrap regression that unit tests could not see.

Everything else that nightly currently re-runs (unit shards, analyze, coverage, duplication/CRAP gates — audit the actual nightly workflow legs) gets REMOVED as duplication of the pre-merge gate.

## Acceptance

1. Audit nightly workflow legs; classify each as {duplicates pre-merge gate} vs {nightly-native: builds, integration tests}; the issue body lists the classification.
2. Remove the duplicating legs; keep builds + integration-only. Nightly wall time must measurably drop (note before/after in the PR).
3. Integration leg stays red-visible: its failures keep filing flake/red issues via the intake (retargeted per #1537 if needed).
4. Docs updated (AGENTS.md quality gates / docs/) to state: unit+coverage+static = pre-merge only; integration+builds = nightly.
5. If the team later wants nightly fully testless, integration tests move to on-demand/pre-release — explicitly OUT of scope here.

Refs: #1537 (retire post-merge main CI — the pre-merge gate becomes the single test gate), #1510 (proof the integration leg earns its keep).

blocks.text:
# Nightly full-matrix quality run (issue #177, Wave 3 / AC6): the PR-level
# ci.yml was slimmed down for speed, so this workflow preserves the original
# monolith semantics — every gate, full thresholds — on a nightly schedule.
# When a scheduled run goes red, the auto-issue job files (or updates) a
# single deduped `nightly-red` issue.
name: Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

# SEC-08 (#796): minimal default — the nightly-red filing job grants
# issues: write (+ actions: read) in its own job-level block.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # Publish gate at PR time: publish-blocking problems (undeclared lib/
      # imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface only in the tag-time
      # publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared package:cryptography
      # import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags. --ignore-warnings: the
      # two known layout warnings (gitignored install_local.sh, docs/
      # naming) must not redden every PR, while validation ERRORS — "does
      # not have X in the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml" — still
      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find lib test example -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: dart analyze
        run: dart analyze

      - name: dart test --coverage (excluding integration)
        run: dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): integration-tagged jsr
      # delegate suites feed the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet AND must
      # reach this unit-side lcov (the 80% ratchet + CRAP below read it) —
      # same rationale as scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        run: dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Coverage ratchet (lib/ >= 80%)
        run: python3 scripts/check_coverage.py 80

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        run: |
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh. Bounded: a
          # floating >= would auto-adopt 0.11.0+ with no repo change.
          # gh-1106: ceiling bumped to 0.12.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml
          # duplication block now uses 0.11.0-only keys.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys
          try:
              with open('/tmp/jscpd-ci/jscpd-report.json') as f:
                  pct = json.load(f)['statistics']['total']['percentage']
          except Exception:
              pct = 0.0
          print(f'Duplication: {pct}% (threshold < 1.0%)')
          sys.exit(0 if float(pct) < 1.0 else 1)
          EOF

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration).
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.

blocks.text:
# Weekly CLI-coverage gardener (issue #177 follow-up, reworked by #927):
# re-measures the terminal/PTY integration suites' coverage of lib/src/cli/**
# and, when it grew, files/updates an issue assigned to ai-teammate asking
# for the baseline raise. The baseline itself NO LONGER auto-commits: every
# bump of scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt lands only through a reviewed PR
# whose per-PR ratchet gate (gh-1005: ci.yml's pty-integration-linux leg,
# the single hosted-linux PTY leg) passes green, and
# each bump must be traceable to a merged PTY test with real frame
# assertions (#927 contract). The nightly ratchet (check_cli_coverage.py)
# still enforces the committed floor — coverage can only ratchet UP, a
# silent regression in terminal-test coverage reddens nightly.
name: CLI coverage gardener

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '53 4 * * 1' # Monday, after the shard rebalance
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  measure-and-file:
    name: Measure CLI coverage, file raise-to-X issue if higher
    # gh-1005: measure on the SAME environment the per-PR ratchet measures —
    # ubuntu-24.04-arm (pure-dart job per the runner-split note; OS-identical
    # line hits to the x64 queue).
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Run PTY/CLI integration suites with coverage
        env:
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
          OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
          --coverage=coverage

      - run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - name: File coverage-growth issue when measured exceeds baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          measured=$(python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py --print | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+')
          baseline=$(cat scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt)
          echo "measured=$measured baseline=$baseline"
          if ! python3 -c "exit(0 if float('$measured') > float('$baseline') else 1)"; then
            echo "No growth — baseline stays $baseline"
            exit 0
          fi
          title="raise coverage to $measured"
          body="$(printf 'Weekly CLI-coverage gardener measured **%s**%% on lib/src/cli/** — above the committed floor of **%s**%% (scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt).\n\nPer the #927 contract the baseline never auto-commits: land the raise through a reviewed PR that\n- updates scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt to %s,\n- passes the per-PR pty-integration-linux ratchet gate green, and\n- traces every bump to a merged PTY test with real frame assertions.\n' "$measured" "$baseline" "$measured")"
          number=$(gh issue list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --search "in:title \"raise coverage to\"" --json number,createdAt --jq 'sort_by(.createdAt) | map(.number) | last // empty')
          if [ -n "$number" ]; then
            gh issue edit "$number" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$title" --body "$body"
            echo "updated issue #$number"
          else
            # The #927 AC wants the raise-to-X issue assigned to ai-teammate;
            # keep the measured number alive even when the login is not
            # assignable (renamed/removed) — file unassigned as a fallback.
            gh issue create -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --assignee ai-teammate --title "$title" --body "$body" ||
              gh issue create -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$title" --body "$body"
            echo "filed raise-to-$measured issue"
          fi

Coverage-gardener is independent (runs its own tests). Good.

# Runner split (gh-1005, 2026-09-30): pure-Dart AND all PTY/terminal jobs ->
# ubuntu-24.04-arm (public repo: free, SEPARATE capacity pool from the x64
# queue). Flutter-test legs on arm64 bootstrap the SDK via git clone — Flutter
# ships NO official linux-arm64 SDK (stable manifest is x64 only;
# subosito/flutter-action fails 'version: any architecture: arm64'); x64
# Flutter jobs keep the action. The self-hosted M5 pool is ONE runner
# (fa-m5-1, user LaunchAgent) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work:
# cube-kernel-live. PR PTY legs (integration shards, coverage/duration gates,
# Terminal visual) run hosted-Linux only and never wait on fa-m5-1.
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  # Dispatch-only CI on PR heads (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes
  # fire NO CI — the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger.
  # It dispatches this workflow on the PR head when validation is due
  # (validate-fresh / validate-armed rules), so intermediate dev/rework
  # pushes and silent branch updates are free. Required checks still
  # match: the dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseDryRun:
        description: 'gh-1172: run the release pipeline without the push/tag (logs the commit+tag that WOULD land)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      releaseDispatch:
        description: 'gh-1172: real release (bump push + tag) on manual dispatch — requires refs/heads/main; bare validation dispatches stay inert'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Any release publication (API `gh release create`, web UI, or a pushed
  # annotated tag) builds + attaches the binaries matrix. Pushed tags also
  # arrive via the push filter above; the binaries job tolerates the
  # double-fire (duplicate create + --clobber upload, last wins).
  release:
    types: [published]
  schedule:
    # Coalesced auto-release catch-up: when pushes outpace the 2h coalesce
    # window, this releases the pending commits (pub.dev caps ~12 publishes/day).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Main/tag runs are
# never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;

pty-coverage-gate:
    name: PTY gates (coverage ratchet + duration budget, merged shards)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [pty-integration-linux]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      # gh-1300: issues: write — the duration-budget auto-filer files/
      # comments/closes the [ENH] optimization issue. A job-level
      # permissions block drops every unlisted scope to none, so both
      # scopes are listed explicitly (the filing leg reads nothing else).
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: pty-coverage-shard-*
          path: pty-coverage-shards
      # Same discipline as the core/faui shards' assert_shard_manifest: the 3
      # selections must cover exactly the integration-tagged suite
      # (browser-ext excluded, it owns browser-ext.yml), pairwise disjoint,
      # every unit on disk. Fails loudly BEFORE the ratchet reads shard data.
      - name: Assert integration shard manifest (union/disjoint/exists)
        run: python3 scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json --shards 3 --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm
      # The leg's dart json reports for the #928 duration gate below.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: integration-json-shard-*
          path: integration-json-shards
      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        run: |
          count=$(ls pty-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
          if [ "$count" != "3" ]; then
            echo "::error::expected 3 pty shard coverage reports, got $count"
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-995: a report that downloads but carries no SF: records
          # (empty/truncated upload) still satisfies the count check and
          # merges into a silently partial report — the 2026-09-27 wedge
          # also showed the ratchet reading 7.95% vs the 11.00% baseline
          # off exactly such a merge. Fail loudly naming the hollow shard
          # instead of letting the ratchet chase a phantom regression.
          for f in pty-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info; do
            grep -q '^SF:' "$f" || { echo "::error::$f carries no SF: records — hollow shard coverage upload"; exit 1; }
          done
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py \
            -o coverage/lcov.merged.info \
            pty-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py --lcov coverage/lcov.merged.info
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, ratchet only down)
        run: |
          ls integration-json-shards/*
          python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py \
            --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json \
            integration-json-shards/*/integration-shard-*.json
      # gh-1300: per-SHARD budget (expected runner span + headroom, one
      # place: scripts/test_shard_budgets.json). Breach fails the job
      # LOUDLY and writes the [ENH] issue body the filer step below posts
      # — crossing the line always produces work, never a silent bump.
      - name: Shard duration budget gate (gh-1300, down-only ratchet)
        id: shard_budget
        run: |
          python3 scripts/check_shard_durations.py \
            --budgets scripts/test_shard_budgets.json \
            --issue-body duration-budget-issue.md \
            --run-url "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            integration-json-shards/*/integration-shard-*.json
      # Best-effort on forks (their GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write issues);
      # the gate failure above is the loud part. Deduped: an open
      # duration-budget issue is commented with the fresh numbers, not
      # duplicated (the nightly-red / flake-quarantine pattern).
      - name: File the duration-budget optimization issue (gh-1300)
        if: always() && steps.shard_budget.outcome == 'failure'
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          repo="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          gh label create duration-budget --force \
            --description "PTY/CLI shard over its duration budget (gh-1300)" \
            --color D93F0B --repo "$repo"
          title="[ENH] PTY/CLI shard duration budget breach (auto-filed)"
          existing=$(gh issue list --state open --label duration-budget \
            --json number --jq '.[0].number' --repo "$repo")
          if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$existing" --body-file duration-budget-issue.md \
              --repo "$repo"
          else
            gh issue create --title "$title" --label duration-budget \
              --body-file duration-budget-issue.md \
              --assignee ai-teammate --repo "$repo"
          fi
      # The auto-filed issue closes only when the run fits under the
      # budget again — the green path of THIS step is that proof.
      - name: Close the duration-budget issue on a fitting run
        if: always() && steps.shard_budget.outcome == 'success'
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          repo="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          existing=$(gh issue list --state open --label duration-budget \
            --json number --jq '.[0].number' --repo "$repo")
          if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$existing" --repo "$repo" \
              --body "Fits under budget again: ${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${repo}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID} — closing."
            gh issue close "$existing" --repo "$repo"
          fi

      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Git bootstrap
      # (same as the flutter-tests leg): flutter_tools pulls the official
      # arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: touch .env
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The harness spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` FROM THE REPO ROOT; without
      # a root package config it resolves the package to the pub-cache copy
      # (an old published build) and the CLI dies before the first frame.
      - run: dart pub get
      # Issue #943 (vector 3): warm the build hooks — the cli_visual harness
      # spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` from the repo root and its boot budget
      # must not pay the cold-hook cost (tui_prototype_snapshot ×5).
      - name: Prewarm build hooks + fa boot
        run: |
          dart bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
          dart run bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
      - name: flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cli-visual-screenshots-pr
          path: test/integration/screenshots/
          retention-days: 7

# gh-1538: [GOAL] Slim nightly to builds + integration-only: drop test legs duplicated by the pre-merge gate

## Description

## Owner directive

Separate card from #1537. Once #1537 makes the SM pre-merge validation the single test gate, the nightly workflow must stop re-running anything that gate already covers. Nightly keeps only what belongs there by nature:

- **Builds** (all store/desktop targets, as today).
- **Integration-tagged tests** (PTY/CLI integration, LLM-calling `integration` tag) — they are deliberately excluded from pre-commit and PR gates (slow, networked, flakier), and nightly is their only home. This leg pays for itself: it caught the #1510 TUI wrap regression that unit tests could not see.

Everything else that nightly currently re-runs (unit shards, analyze, coverage, duplication/CRAP gates — audit the actual nightly workflow legs) gets REMOVED as duplication of the pre-merge gate.

## Acceptance

1. Audit nightly workflow legs; classify each as {duplicates pre-merge gate} vs {nightly-native: builds, integration tests}; the issue body lists the classification.
2. Remove the duplicating legs; keep builds + integration-only. Nightly wall time must measurably drop (note before/after in the PR).
3. Integration leg stays red-visible: its failures keep filing flake/red issues via the intake (retargeted per #1537 if needed).
4. Docs updated (AGENTS.md quality gates / docs/) to state: unit+coverage+static = pre-merge only; integration+builds = nightly.
5. If the team later wants nightly fully testless, integration tests move to on-demand/pre-release — explicitly OUT of scope here.

Refs: #1537 (retire post-merge main CI — the pre-merge gate becomes the single test gate), #1510 (proof the integration leg earns its keep).

blocks.text:
# Nightly full-matrix quality run (issue #177, Wave 3 / AC6): the PR-level
# ci.yml was slimmed down for speed, so this workflow preserves the original
# monolith semantics — every gate, full thresholds — on a nightly schedule.
# When a scheduled run goes red, the auto-issue job files (or updates) a
# single deduped `nightly-red` issue.
name: Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

# SEC-08 (#796): minimal default — the nightly-red filing job grants
# issues: write (+ actions: read) in its own job-level block.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # Publish gate at PR time: publish-blocking problems (undeclared lib/
      # imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface only in the tag-time
      # publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared package:cryptography
      # import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags. --ignore-warnings: the
      # two known layout warnings (gitignored install_local.sh, docs/
      # naming) must not redden every PR, while validation ERRORS — "does
      # not have X in the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml" — still
      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find lib test example -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: dart analyze
        run: dart analyze

      - name: dart test --coverage (excluding integration)
        run: dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): integration-tagged jsr
      # delegate suites feed the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet AND must
      # reach this unit-side lcov (the 80% ratchet + CRAP below read it) —
      # same rationale as scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        run: dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Coverage ratchet (lib/ >= 80%)
        run: python3 scripts/check_coverage.py 80

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        run: |
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh. Bounded: a
          # floating >= would auto-adopt 0.11.0+ with no repo change.
          # gh-1106: ceiling bumped to 0.12.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml
          # duplication block now uses 0.11.0-only keys.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys
          try:
              with open('/tmp/jscpd-ci/jscpd-report.json') as f:
                  pct = json.load(f)['statistics']['total']['percentage']
          except Exception:
              pct = 0.0
          print(f'Duplication: {pct}% (threshold < 1.0%)')
          sys.exit(0 if float(pct) < 1.0 else 1)
          EOF

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ r…

- Bundled Codex model catalog

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration).
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs in the
  nightly workflow + on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet on main/nightly; PRs ratchet
  CHANGED lines via `scripts/diff_coverage.py`); jscpd duplication < 1%
  core `lib/`, < 3.7% `flutter_app/lib/` (ratchet — only tighten).
- Cross-module duplication (issue #487): clones spanning module roots
  (`lib`, `bin`, `flutter_app/lib`, `packages/*/lib`, `browser_ext/dart`)
  via `scripts/check_dup_cross_module.sh` — stage `dupx`, ONE jscpd
  invocation, marker-parity with the CI `guards` job (which also runs it
  for app-only PRs — cross-module clones are usually born app-side).
  Baseline 0.3013% of the combined ~283k lines, pinned 0.31 in
  `ci_fast_gate.sh` (ratchet — only tighten; the per-package gates above
  cannot see across module boundaries).
- CRAP ratchet (`crap4dart analyze`, tool pinned as
  `dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"` — gh-1106
  superseded the old 0.10 bound; gates/baselines need 0.11), one config
  per package, thresholds are the current per-package max — only down
  from here:
  - core (`crap4dart.yaml`, sources `[lib, bin]`): **12.0** (issue #1234:
    the named census offenders moved — CC-12 trio + readPasteboardImage
    16.32 split, the 0%-cov CC-3 quartet and the named CC-9 tier covered
    or split, `_listModels` covered — but the first whole-tree
    measurement showed the 8.0 repin unearned: 54 methods at 12.00
    (CC-3@0% tier + covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00. Threshold
    stays at the measured max; the tier is the next ladder card).
  - flutter_app (`flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`, sources `[lib]`,
    issue #433/#475): **30.0** — measured by the SAME pipeline the CI gate
    uses (the two `flutter-tests` shards emit `--coverage`; the
    `app-crap-gate` job merges the lcovs and runs the pinned analyzer —
    widget-test coverage differs from the core's dart lcov, E2).
  - The app ladder (follow-up cards, NOT this one): 2450 → 870 → 702 → 650
    → 380 → 272 → 210 (done: `JsAppEngine._faCall` 2450→6 via map
    dispatch, `patch` 94→19, `_tokenize` 70→18; issue #475:
    `wasm_shell_git.run` route-table + 51 golden tests, app `main()`
    boot-phase helpers, `wasm_shell` beasts `_grepBuiltin` 812→covered
    parse helpers, `_runPipeline` 702→210, `_runStage` 600→380,
    `_parsePrimary` 506→210; issue #558: the wasm_shell pipeline engine
    (`_runStage` 380→4, `_runPipeline` 210→4, `_evalExpr` 182→3); issue
    #559: the wasm_shell builtins (`_xargsBuiltin` 272→7,
    `_TestEvaluator._parsePrimary` 210→3, `_trBuiltin` 210→4,
    `_testBuiltin` 132→9, `_duBuiltin` 132→3, `_expandTrSet` 110→gone,
    `_tacBuiltin` 90→6, `_pipBuiltin` 72→3 — spec/table-driven parse
    helpers in `wasm_shell_builtins.dart` + tested exec halves) → next
    milestone 210-class (`GemmaService.chatStream`, `_statBuiltin` 156,
    wide_layout 156 pair) → … → **40**, each step "fix the code, then
    lower the threshold" — never lower first.
  - Guards (`scripts/check_crap_guards.py`): README badge == config
    threshold for BOTH packages, generated-exclude parity between the
    two configs, and `--only-down` (a PR that raises any threshold vs
    the merge base is rejected in CI).
- Max 2800 lines per `.dart` file (crap4dart `loc` gate, issue #1234 —
  generated output excluded in the gate configs; `*.g.dart` exempt).
- CI layout: `changes` (path filter) → parallel `static`, `test-core`
  (3 duration-balanced shards, `scripts/test_shards.json`, rebalanced
  weekly from junit durations; shard jobs emit junit-shard-N artifacts and
  `shard_files.py` bin-packs manifest-missing new test dirs at runtime),
  `coverage-gate`, `guards`, `flutter-tests` (ubuntu; goldens stay
  host-locked in build-macos/nightly) → one aggregate `Quality gate`
  required check, plus `step-timings` (per-step duration telemetry) and a
  `watchdog` (>2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out PR leg gets ONE
  empty-commit retrigger — never `gh run rerun`, which reallocates into
  the same degraded runner pool). `perf-gate` (issue #303) folds the #262

  trajectory-touching PRs. Issue #551 adds the `integration-mock` leg to

  MockLlmServer); the tag-only `integration` job is just the llm provider

  `flutter-app-exzone` leg: it runs the macOS exclusion-zone family
  (`flutter_app/test/apps/` — JS-engine tests the ubuntu leg skips via
  `native_test_guard.dart`, plus `flutter_app/lib/apps/` + `lib/src/js_ext/`

# Weekly CLI-coverage gardener (issue #177 follow-up, reworked by #927):
# re-measures the terminal/PTY integration suites' coverage of lib/src/cli/**
# and, when it grew, files/updates an issue assigned to ai-teammate asking
# for the baseline raise. The baseline itself NO LONGER auto-commits: every
# bump of scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt lands only through a reviewed PR
# whose per-PR ratchet gate (gh-1005: ci.yml's pty-integration-linux leg,
# the single hosted-linux PTY leg) passes green, and
# each bump must be traceable to a merged PTY test with real frame
# assertions (#927 contract). The nightly ratchet (check_cli_coverage.py)
# still enforces the committed floor — coverage can only ratchet UP, a
# silent regression in terminal-test coverage reddens nightly.
name: CLI coverage gardener

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '53 4 * * 1' # Monday, after the shard rebalance
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  measure-and-file:
    name: Measure CLI coverage, file raise-to-X issue if higher
    # gh-1005: measure on the SAME environment the per-PR ratchet measures —
    # ubuntu-24.04-arm (pure-dart job per the runner-split note; OS-identical
    # line hits to the x64 queue).
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Run PTY/CLI integration suites with coverage
        env:
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
          OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
          --coverage=coverage

      - run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - name: File coverage-growth issue when measured exceeds baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          measured=$(python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py --print | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+')
          baseline=$(cat scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt)
          echo "measured=$measured baseline=$baseline"
          if ! python3 -c "exit(0 if float('$measured') > float('$baseline') else 1)"; then
            echo "No growth — baseline stays $baseline"
            exit 0
          fi
          title="raise coverage to $measured"
          body="$(printf 'Weekly CLI-coverage gardener measured **%s**%% on lib/src/cli/** — above the committed floor of **%s**%% (scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt).\n\nPer the #927 contract the baseline never auto-commits: land the raise through a reviewed PR that\n- updates scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt to %s,\n- passes the per-PR pty-integration-linux ratchet gate green, and\n- traces every bump to a merged PTY test with real frame assertions.\n' "$measured" "$baseline" "$measured")"
          number=$(gh issue list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --search "in:title \"raise coverage to\"" --json number,createdAt --jq 'sort_by(.createdAt) | map(.number) | last // empty')
          if [ -n "$number" ]; then
            gh issue edit "$number" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$title" --body "$body"
            echo "updated issue #$number"
          else
            # The #927 AC wants the raise-to-X issue assigned to ai-teammate;
            # keep the measured number alive even when the login is not
            # assignable (renamed/removed) — file unassigned as a fallback.
            gh issue create -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --assignee ai-teammate --title "$title" --body "$body" ||
              gh issue create -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$title" --body "$body"
            echo "filed raise-to-$measured issue"
          fi

# Runner split (gh-1005, 2026-09-30): pure-Dart AND all PTY/terminal jobs ->
# ubuntu-24.04-arm (public repo: free, SEPARATE capacity pool from the x64
# queue). Flutter-test legs on arm64 bootstrap the SDK via git clone — Flutter
# ships NO official linux-arm64 SDK (stable manifest is x64 only;
# subosito/flutter-action fails 'version: any architecture: arm64'); x64
# Flutter jobs keep the action. The self-hosted M5 pool is ONE runner
# (fa-m5-1, user LaunchAgent) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work:
# cube-kernel-live. PR PTY legs (integration shards, coverage/duration gates,
# Terminal visual) run hosted-Linux only and never wait on fa-m5-1.
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  # Dispatch-only CI on PR heads (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes
  # fire NO CI — the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger.
  # It dispatches this workflow on the PR head when validation is due
  # (validate-fresh / validate-armed rules), so intermediate dev/rework
  # pushes and silent branch updates are free. Required checks still
  # match: the dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseDryRun:
        description: 'gh-1172: run the release pipeline without the push/tag (logs the commit+tag that WOULD land)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      releaseDispatch:
        description: 'gh-1172: real release (bump push + tag) on manual dispatch — requires refs/heads/main; bare validation dispatches stay inert'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Any release publication (API `gh release create`, web UI, or a pushed
  # annotated tag) builds + attaches the binaries matrix. Pushed tags also
  # arrive via the push filter above; the binaries job tolerates the
  # double-fire (duplicate create + --clobber upload, last wins).
  release:
    types: [published]
  schedule:
    # Coalesced auto-release catch-up: when pushes outpace the 2h coalesce
    # window, this releases the pending commits (pub.dev caps ~12 publishes/day).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Main/tag runs are
# never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

pty-coverage-gate:
    name: PTY gates (coverage ratchet + duration budget, merged shards)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [pty-integration-linux]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      # gh-1300: issues: write — the duration-budget auto-filer files/
      # comments/closes the [ENH] optimization issue. A job-level
      # permissions block drops every unlisted scope to none, so both
      # scopes are listed explicitly (the filing leg reads nothing else).
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: pty-coverage-shard-*
          path: pty-coverage-shards
      # Same discipline as the core/faui shards' assert_shard_manifest: the 3
      # selections must cover exactly the integration-tagged suite
      # (browser-ext excluded, it owns browser-ext.yml), pairwise disjoint,
      # every unit on disk. Fails loudly BEFORE the ratchet reads shard data.
      - name: Assert integration shard manifest (union/disjoint/exists)
        run: python3 scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json --shards 3 --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm
      # The leg's dart json reports for the #928 duration gate below.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: integration-json-shard-*
          path: integration-json-shards
      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        run: |
          count=$(ls pty-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
          if [ "$count" != "3" ]; then
            echo "::error::expected 3 pty shard coverage reports, got $count"
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-995: a report that downloads but carries no SF: records
          # (empty/truncated upload) still satisfies the count check and
          # merges into a silently partial report — the 2026-09-27 wedge
          # also showed the ratchet reading 7.95% vs the 11.00% baseline
          # off exactly such a merge. Fail loudly naming the hollow shard
          # instead of letting the ratchet chase a phantom regression.
          for f in pty-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info; do
            grep -q '^SF:' "$f" || { echo "::error::$f carries no SF: records — hollow shard coverage upload"; exit 1; }
          done
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py \
            -o coverage/lcov.merged.info \
            pty-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py --lcov coverage/lcov.merged.info
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, ratchet only down)
        run: |
          ls integration-json-shards/*
          python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py \
            --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json \
            integration-json-shards/*/integration-shard-*.json
      # gh-1300: per-SHARD budget (expected runner span + headroom, one
      # place: scripts/test_shard_budgets.json). Breach fails the job
      # LOUDLY and writes the [ENH] issue body the filer step below posts
      # — crossing the line always produces work, never a silent bump.
      - name: Shard duration budget gate (gh-1300, down-only ratchet)
        id: shard_budget
        run: |
          python3 scripts/check_shard_durations.py \
            --budgets scripts/test_shard_budgets.json \
            --issue-body duration-budget-issue.md \
            --run-url "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            integration-json-shards/*/integration-shard-*.json
      # Best-effort on forks (their GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write issues);
      # the gate failure above is the loud part. Deduped: an open
      # duration-budget issue is commented with the fresh numbers, not
      # duplicated (the nightly-red / flake-quarantine pattern).
      - name: File the duration-budget optimization issue (gh-1300)
        if: always() && steps.shard_budget.outcome == 'failure'
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          repo="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          gh label create duration-budget --force \
            --description "PTY/CLI shard over its duration budget (gh-1300)" \
            --color D93F0B --repo "$repo"
          title="[ENH] PTY/CLI shard duration budget breach (auto-filed)"
          existing=$(gh issue list --state open --label duration-budget \
            --json number --jq '.[0].number' --repo "$repo")
          if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$existing" --body-file duration-budget-issue.md \
              --repo "$repo"
          else
            gh issue create --title "$title" --label duration-budget \
              --body-file duration-budget-issue.md \
              --assignee ai-teammate --repo "$repo"
          fi
      # The auto-filed issue closes only when the run fits under the
      # budget again — the green path of THIS step is that proof.
      - name: Close the duration-budget issue on a fitting run
        if: always() && steps.shard_budget.outcome == 'success'
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          repo="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          existing=$(gh issue list --state open --label duration-budget \
            --json number --jq '.[0].number' --repo "$repo")
          if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$existing" --repo "$repo" \
              --body "Fits under budget again: ${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${repo}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID} — closing."
            gh issue close "$existing" --repo "$repo"
          fi

- name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # Main remains backstopped by nightly.yml.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.
  fa-aot-build:
    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
====
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core and
      # nightly.yml.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage
          test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart
          test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          name: coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # junit durations for the weekly shard-rebalance.yml (retention 7d so
      # a quiet week never starves it into the file-count fallback).
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          name: junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
          retention-days: 7

  # Issue #551: the no-key integration legs (MockLlmServer scenarios, PTY
  # harness, no secrets, no network) run per-PR whenever test/integration/**
  # changes — the #538 rot class (legs breaking silently between releases,

  # them. Real-provider legs carry the `llm` tag and stay in the tag-only

  # its own workflow. `pty` marks child-agent-spawn tests whose second

    name: Integration tests (mock LLM)

pty-visual:
    name: Terminal visual (PTY screenshots, PR)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Git bootstrap
      # (same as the flutter-tests leg): flutter_tools pulls the official
      # arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: touch .env
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The harness spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` FROM THE REPO ROOT; without
      # a root package config it resolves the package to the pub-cache copy
      # (an old published build) and the CLI dies before the first frame.
      - run: dart pub get
      # Issue #943 (vector 3): warm the build hooks — the cli_visual harness
      # spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` from the repo root and its boot budget
      # must not pay the cold-hook cost (tui_prototype_snapshot ×5).
      - name: Prewarm build hooks + fa boot
        run: |
          dart bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
          dart run bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
      - name: flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cli-visual-screenshots-pr
          path: test/integration/screenshots/
          retention-days: 7

  coverage-gate:
====

# gh-1538: [GOAL] Slim nightly to builds + integration-only: drop test legs duplicated by the pre-merge gate

## Description

## Owner directive

Separate card from #1537. Once #1537 makes the SM pre-merge validation the single test gate, the nightly workflow must stop re-running anything that gate already covers. Nightly keeps only what belongs there by nature:

- **Builds** (all store/desktop targets, as today).
- **Integration-tagged tests** (PTY/CLI integration, LLM-calling `integration` tag) — they are deliberately excluded from pre-commit and PR gates (slow, networked, flakier), and nightly is their only home. This leg pays for itself: it caught the #1510 TUI wrap regression that unit tests could not see.

Everything else that nightly currently re-runs (unit shards, analyze, coverage, duplication/CRAP gates — audit the actual nightly workflow legs) gets REMOVED as duplication of the pre-merge gate.

## Acceptance

1. Audit nightly workflow legs; classify each as {duplicates pre-merge gate} vs {nightly-native: builds, integration tests}; the issue body lists the classification.
2. Remove the duplicating legs; keep builds + integration-only. Nightly wall time must measurably drop (note before/after in the PR).
3. Integration leg stays red-visible: its failures keep filing flake/red issues via the intake (retargeted per #1537 if needed).
4. Docs updated (AGENTS.md quality gates / docs/) to state: unit+coverage+static = pre-merge only; integration+builds = nightly.
5. If the team later wants nightly fully testless, integration tests move to on-demand/pre-release — explicitly OUT of scope here.

Refs: #1537 (retire post-merge main CI — the pre-merge gate becomes the single test gate), #1510 (proof the integration leg earns its keep).

blocks.text:
# Nightly full-matrix quality run (issue #177, Wave 3 / AC6): the PR-level
# ci.yml was slimmed down for speed, so this workflow preserves the original
# monolith semantics — every gate, full thresholds — on a nightly schedule.
# When a scheduled run goes red, the auto-issue job files (or updates) a
# single deduped `nightly-red` issue.
name: Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

# SEC-08 (#796): minimal default — the nightly-red filing job grants
# issues: write (+ actions: read) in its own job-level block.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # Publish gate at PR time: publish-blocking problems (undeclared lib/
      # imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface only in the tag-time
      # publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared package:cryptography
      # import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags. --ignore-warnings: the
      # two known layout warnings (gitignored install_local.sh, docs/
      # naming) must not redden every PR, while validation ERRORS — "does
      # not have X in the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml" — still
      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find lib test example -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: dart analyze
        run: dart analyze

      - name: dart test --coverage (excluding integration)
        run: dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): integration-tagged jsr
      # delegate suites feed the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet AND must
      # reach this unit-side lcov (the 80% ratchet + CRAP below read it) —
      # same rationale as scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        run: dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Coverage ratchet (lib/ >= 80%)
        run: python3 scripts/check_coverage.py 80

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        run: |
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh. Bounded: a
          # floating >= would auto-adopt 0.11.0+ with no repo change.
          # gh-1106: ceiling bumped to 0.12.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml
          # duplication block now uses 0.11.0-only keys.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys
          try:
              with open('/tmp/jscpd-ci/jscpd-report.json') as f:
                  pct = json.load(f)['statistics']['total']['percentage']
          except Exception:
              pct = 0.0
          print(f'Duplication: {pct}% (threshold < 1.0%)')
          sys.exit(0 if float(pct) < 1.0 else 1)
          EOF

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ r…

- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from

  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when

  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration).
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs in the
  nightly workflow + on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet on main/nightly; PRs ratchet
  CHANGED lines via `scripts/diff_coverage.py`); jscpd duplication < 1%
  core `lib/`, < 3.7% `flutter_app/lib/` (ratchet — only tighten).
- Cross-module duplication (issue #487): clones spanning module roots
  (`lib`, `bin`, `flutter_app/lib`, `packages/*/lib`, `browser_ext/dart`)
  via `scripts/check_dup_cross_module.sh` — stage `dupx`, ONE jscpd
  invocation, marker-parity with the CI `guards` job (which also runs it
  for app-only PRs — cross-module clones are usually born app-side).
  Baseline 0.3013% of the combined ~283k lines, pinned 0.31 in
  `ci_fast_gate.sh` (ratchet — only tighten; the per-package gates above
  cannot see across module boundaries).
