blocks.text:
pty-coverage-gate:
    name: PTY gates (coverage ratchet + duration budget, merged shards)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [pty-integration-linux]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      # gh-1300: issues: write — the duration-budget auto-filer files/
      # comments/closes the [ENH] optimization issue. A job-level
      # permissions block drops every unlisted scope to none, so both
      # scopes are listed explicitly (the filing leg reads nothing else).
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: pty-coverage-shard-*
          path: pty-coverage-shards
      # Same discipline as the core/faui shards' assert_shard_manifest: the 3
      # selections must cover exactly the integration-tagged suite
      # (browser-ext excluded, it owns browser-ext.yml), pairwise disjoint,
      # every unit on disk. Fails loudly BEFORE the ratchet reads shard data.
      - name: Assert integration shard manifest (union/disjoint/exists)
        run: python3 scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json --shards 3 --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm
      # The leg's dart json reports for the #928 duration gate below.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: integration-json-shard-*
          path: integration-json-shards
      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        run: |
          count=$(ls pty-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
          if [ "$count" != "3" ]; then
            echo "::error::expected 3 pty shard coverage reports, got $count"
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-995: a report that downloads but carries no SF: records
          # (empty/truncated upload) still satisfies the count check and
          # merges into a silently partial report — the 2026-09-27 wedge
          # also showed the ratchet reading 7.95% vs the 11.00% baseline
          # off exactly such a merge. Fail loudly naming the hollow shard
          # instead of letting the ratchet chase a phantom regression.
          for f in pty-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info; do
            grep -q '^SF:' "$f" || { echo "::error::$f carries no SF: records — hollow shard coverage upload"; exit 1; }
          done
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py \
            -o coverage/lcov.merged.info \
            pty-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py --lcov coverage/lcov.merged.info
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, ratchet only down)
        run: |
          ls integration-json-shards/*
          python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py \
            --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json \
            integration-json-shards/*/integration-shard-*.json
      # gh-1300: per-SHARD budget (expected runner span + headroom, one
      # place: scripts/test_shard_budgets.json). Breach fails the job
      # LOUDLY and writes the [ENH] issue body the filer step below posts
      # — crossing the line always produces work, never a silent bump.
      - name: Shard duration budget gate (gh-1300, down-only ratchet)
        id: shard_budget
        run: |
          python3 scripts/check_shard_durations.py \
            --budgets scripts/test_shard_budgets.json \
            --issue-body duration-budget-issue.md \
            --run-url "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            integration-json-shards/*/integration-shard-*.json
      # Best-effort on forks (their GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write issues);
      # the gate failure above is the loud part. Deduped: an open
      # duration-budget issue is commented with the fresh numbers, not
      # duplicated (the nightly-red / flake-quarantine pattern).
      - name: File the duration-budget optimization issue (gh-1300)
        if: always() && steps.shard_budget.outcome == 'failure'
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          repo="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          gh label create duration-budget --force \
            --description "PTY/CLI shard over its duration budget (gh-1300)" \
            --color D93F0B --repo "$repo"
          title="[ENH] PTY/CLI shard duration budget breach (auto-filed)"
          existing=$(gh issue list --state open --label duration-budget \
            --json number --jq '.[0].number' --repo "$repo")
          if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$existing" --body-file duration-budget-issue.md \
              --repo "$repo"
          else
            gh issue create --title "$title" --label duration-budget \
              --body-file duration-budget-issue.md \
              --assignee ai-teammate --repo "$repo"
          fi
      # The auto-filed issue closes only when the run fits under the
      # budget again — the green path of THIS step is that proof.
      - name: Close the duration-budget issue on a fitting run
        if: always() && steps.shard_budget.outcome == 'success'
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          repo="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          existing=$(gh issue list --state open --label duration-budget \
            --json number --jq '.[0].number' --repo "$repo")
          if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$existing" --repo "$repo" \
              --body "Fits under budget again: ${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${repo}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID} — closing."
            gh issue close "$existing" --repo "$repo"
          fi

  # gh-1005: Terminal visual is platform-independent and pinned to hosted
  # linux arm64. Evidence: every assertion reads the xterm terminal BUFFER /
  # screen text (never pixels — each PNG even ships a .txt twin "for
  # pixel-independent verification"), rendering goes through the BUNDLED
  # JetBrainsMono font (no host system fonts), and pty2 allocates the PTY
  # via libc openpty FFI. Nothing needs macOS — the old fa-m5 / macos-latest
  # routing (10x hosted-macOS minute cost, single-runner queue risk) is
  # gone; the nightly keeps an eyeball-only screenshot leg.
  pty-visual:

The pre-merge gate (ci.yml pty-coverage-gate) already enforces the CLI coverage ratchet AND the duration budget gate (check-only vs ratchet, but the pre-merge one is ratchet only down — stricter). So the nightly pty-integration leg's trailing "CLI coverage ratchet" and "Test duration budget gate" steps are duplicated by the pre-merge gate. Per the ticket: remove duplicated legs. The pty-integration job itself is nightly-native (runs live llm suite with secrets, unsharded, un-quarantined). The sub-steps: junit + artifacts (integration-json used by shard-rebalance.yml? pty-visual:
    name: Terminal visual (PTY screenshots, PR)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Git bootstrap
      # (same as the flutter-tests leg): flutter_tools pulls the official
      # arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: touch .env
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The harness spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` FROM THE REPO ROOT; without
      # a root package config it resolves the package to the pub-cache copy
      # (an old published build) and the CLI dies before the first frame.
      - run: dart pub get
      # Issue #943 (vector 3): warm the build hooks — the cli_visual harness
      # spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` from the repo root and its boot budget
      # must not pay the cold-hook cost (tui_prototype_snapshot ×5).
      - name: Prewarm build hooks + fa boot
        run: |
          dart bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
          dart run bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
      - name: flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

blocks.text:
- name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # Main remains backstopped by nightly.yml.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.
  fa-aot-build:
    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
====

          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core and
      # nightly.yml.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage
          test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart
          test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

          name: coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # junit durations for the weekly shard-rebalance.yml (retention 7d so
      # a quiet week never starves it into the file-count fallback).
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          name: junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
          retention-days: 7

  # Issue #551: the no-key integration legs (MockLlmServer scenarios, PTY
  # harness, no secrets, no network) run per-PR whenever test/integration/**
  # changes — the #538 rot class (legs breaking silently between releases,

pty-visual:
    name: Terminal visual (PTY screenshots, PR)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Git bootstrap
      # (same as the flutter-tests leg): flutter_tools pulls the official
      # arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: touch .env
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The harness spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` FROM THE REPO ROOT; without
      # a root package config it resolves the package to the pub-cache copy
      # (an old published build) and the CLI dies before the first frame.
      - run: dart pub get
      # Issue #943 (vector 3): warm the build hooks — the cli_visual harness
      # spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` from the repo root and its boot budget
      # must not pay the cold-hook cost (tui_prototype_snapshot ×5).
      - name: Prewarm build hooks + fa boot
        run: |
          dart bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
          dart run bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
      - name: flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cli-visual-screenshots-pr
          path: test/integration/screenshots/
          retention-days: 7

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

- name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # Main remains backstopped by nightly.yml.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.
  fa-aot-build:
    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
====
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})

          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core and
      # nightly.yml.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage
          test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart
          test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          name: coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # junit durations for the weekly shard-rebalance.yml (retention 7d so
      # a quiet week never starves it into the file-count fallback).
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          name: junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
          retention-days: 7

  # Issue #551: the no-key integration legs (MockLlmServer scenarios, PTY
  # harness, no secrets, no network) run per-PR whenever test/integration/**

  # them. Real-provider legs carry the `llm` tag and stay in the tag-only
  # provider-smoke job; perf has its own #303 trajectory gate; browser-ext
  # its own workflow. `pty` marks child-agent-spawn tests whose second
  # process boot is unbounded under runner load (issue #553, red twice on

pty-visual:
    name: Terminal visual (PTY screenshots, PR)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Git bootstrap
      # (same as the flutter-tests leg): flutter_tools pulls the official
      # arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: touch .env
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The harness spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` FROM THE REPO ROOT; without
      # a root package config it resolves the package to the pub-cache copy
      # (an old published build) and the CLI dies before the first frame.
      - run: dart pub get
      # Issue #943 (vector 3): warm the build hooks — the cli_visual harness
      # spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` from the repo root and its boot budget
      # must not pay the cold-hook cost (tui_prototype_snapshot ×5).
      - name: Prewarm build hooks + fa boot
        run: |
          dart bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
          dart run bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
      - name: flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cli-visual-screenshots-pr
          path: test/integration/screenshots/
          retention-days: 7

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

pty-visual:
    name: Terminal visual (PTY screenshots, PR)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Git bootstrap
      # (same as the flutter-tests leg): flutter_tools pulls the official
      # arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: touch .env
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The harness spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` FROM THE REPO ROOT; without
      # a root package config it resolves the package to the pub-cache copy
      # (an old published build) and the CLI dies before the first frame.
      - run: dart pub get
      # Issue #943 (vector 3): warm the build hooks — the cli_visual harness
      # spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` from the repo root and its boot budget
      # must not pay the cold-hook cost (tui_prototype_snapshot ×5).
      - name: Prewarm build hooks + fa boot
        run: |
          dart bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
          dart run bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
      - name: flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cli-visual-screenshots-pr
          path: test/integration/screenshots/
          retention-days: 7

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

pty-visual:
    name: Terminal visual (PTY screenshots, PR)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Git bootstrap
      # (same as the flutter-tests leg): flutter_tools pulls the official
      # arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: touch .env
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The harness spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` FROM THE REPO ROOT; without
      # a root package config it resolves the package to the pub-cache copy
      # (an old published build) and the CLI dies before the first frame.
      - run: dart pub get
      # Issue #943 (vector 3): warm the build hooks — the cli_visual harness
      # spawns `dart bin/fah.dart` from the repo root and its boot budget
      # must not pay the cold-hook cost (tui_prototype_snapshot ×5).
      - name: Prewarm build hooks + fa boot
        run: |
          dart bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
          dart run bin/fah.dart --help > /dev/null
      - name: flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/cli_visual --tags integration
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cli-visual-screenshots-pr
          path: test/integration/screenshots/
          retention-days: 7

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; runs in every SM validation dispatch — path-blind
#               under dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 idiom; the nightly macos leg
#               stays the main/tag backstop)
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
====
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
====
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # Same placeholder assets the nightly cli-visual job and the ubuntu
      # flutter-tests leg create (see those jobs for the why).
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: touch .env

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json
