jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.

          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).

          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"

      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()

          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has

  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the

    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset

        run: touch .env

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-

      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

- CI layout: `changes` (path filter) → parallel `static`, `test-core`

  weekly from junit durations; shard jobs emit junit-shard-N artifacts and
  `shard_files.py` bin-packs manifest-missing new test dirs at runtime),
  `coverage-gate`, `guards`, `flutter-tests` (ubuntu; goldens stay
  host-locked in build-macos/nightly) → one aggregate `Quality gate`
  required check, plus `step-timings` (per-step duration telemetry) and a
  `watchdog` (>2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out PR leg gets ONE
  empty-commit retrigger — never `gh run rerun`, which reallocates into
  the same degraded runner pool). `perf-gate` (issue #303) folds the #262
  DoD `dart test --tags perf` trajectory gate into the aggregate for
  trajectory-touching PRs. Issue #551 adds the `integration-mock` leg to
  the aggregate for `test/integration/**` PRs (no-key legs via
  MockLlmServer); the tag-only `integration` job is just the llm provider
  smoke and `publish` waits on it. Issue #1267 N1 adds the
  `flutter-app-exzone` leg: it runs the macOS exclusion-zone family
  (`flutter_app/test/apps/` — JS-engine tests the ubuntu leg skips via
  `native_test_guard.dart`, plus `flutter_app/lib/apps/` + `lib/src/js_ext/`
  are the code that surfaces there) on macos pre-merge, closing the
  nightly-only gap the #1309 escape rode. Under this repo's dispatch-only
  CI the leg is path-blind: ci.yml has no `pull_request` trigger (SM
  `workflow_dispatch` validation is the PR gate), so the leg runs in every
  SM validation dispatch (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom); the
  `flutter_app/lib/apps/**`/`lib/src/js_ext/**`/`flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`
  path set in the `changes` job only narrows a future real `pull_request`
  trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — `nightly.yml` keeps
  the full-suite macOS backstop there. `nightly.yml` runs the full monolith +
  PTY/CLI integration (full real-provider suite with secrets) +
  terminal-visual suites; `coverage-gardener.yml` measures the only-up CLI
  coverage weekly and files an ai-teammate "raise coverage to X" issue —
  the baseline itself only moves through a reviewed PR (issue #927).

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
        # running here nightly, producing the repeat-run proof its fix PR
        # needs for un-quarantine.
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn runs the AOT binary
          # (~1 s) instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on ARM).
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration.json"
      # Issue #928 review: the file-reporter writes the json even on a RED
      # leg — convert + upload must not be chained into the failing step.
      # The RAW dart json is the machine-parseable form the gate itself
      # consumes (one format, both sides): a budget-tightening PR downloads
      # `integration-json` and runs check_test_durations.py --update-baseline
      # on it; junit stays for the human/rebalancer view.
      - name: junit durations (budget-tightening evidence)
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration.json
          test-results/junit-integration.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: integration-json
          path: test-results/integration.json
          retention-days: 14
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: test-results/junit-integration.xml
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info
      - name: CLI coverage ratchet (lib/src/cli/**, baseline only up)
        run: python3 scripts/check_cli_coverage.py
      - name: Test duration budget gate (issue #928, check-only on schedule)
        run: python3 scripts/check_test_durations.py --baseline scripts/test_duration_baseline.json test-results/integration.json

jobs:

  # PTY/terminal integration suites (issue #177 follow-up): mock-endpoint
  # tests need NO secrets and always run; live-provider tests self-skip
  # gracefully without keys (their own `skip:` guards), so the blanket
  # "no keys → skip everything" from the old CI job is gone. Coverage over
  # lib/src/cli/** feeds the only-up ratchet (coverage-gardener.yml bumps
  # the baseline weekly) — terminal-test coverage can never silently drop.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # gh-1005 (2026-09-30): the fa-m5 runner-pick probe is GONE — the on-prem
  # M5 pool is ONE runner (fa-m5-1) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work
  # (cube-kernel-live, release macOS/iOS legs). The PTY/CLI integration +
  # Terminal-visual legs run on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, mirroring the PR
  # legs in ci.yml so the coverage/duration ratchets measure ONE
  # environment (PR gate == nightly backstop == coverage-gardener).
  pty-integration:
    name: PTY/CLI integration + cli coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: dart pub get
      # gh-1300: compile the AOT bundle ONCE for the whole nightly leg and
      # point the FA_BIN seam at it — same shape as ci.yml's fa-aot-build
      # job (the nightly runs one unsharded job, so the build is in-job).
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, gh-1300)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (excluding browser-ext — it owns browser-ext.yml)
        # gh-1199 AC5/AC6: this unsharded leg (with secrets) is the
        # SUPERVISED home of the live (`llm`) suite — and it deliberately
        # does NOT apply the flake quarantine: a quarantined file keeps
